description: ~/.config/nota/settings.toml. A key set here wins over the app and the account, and the app does not change it.

note_mode.description: How notes open: live (editing with formatting), reading or source.

palette.description: The colour theme, by id (nota, paper, …; a plugin can add more).

properties.description: Whether a note's properties (frontmatter) show above it.

theme.description: Light or dark mode: system follows the operating system.

title: Nota settings
